description: This file provides API functions for fetching user analytics data from a backend service, including active user trends and tenant user summaries. It uses axios for HTTP requests and exports functions for external use.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a trend of active users over a specified period, with optional filters.

params.params: Optional parameters object that can include from, to, status, tenant_id, and granularity.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches an aggregated summary of users per tenant, handling various response shapes and errors.

params.params: Optional parameters object including date range, status, and inclusion of inactive tenants.
